decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted commences on the site an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to the Local Planning Authority.  The investigation will be carried out at such points and to such depth as the Local Planning Authority may stipulate.  A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before any development hereby permitted is first occupied.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to dwellinghouse
